review: Preserves parameters in R4-R7, signed-compares width/height against 1 with the IT-GE second compare, returns unchanged on invalid dimensions or null allocation. On success PKHBT packs x/y and wrapped x+width/y+height, writes fields in order, then fresh-loads global object field and ORs bit 1. Stack frame is 24 bytes; pop restores entry context.
limitations: Fresh pinned-byte replay passed and decoded instruction operations were checked against the pseudocode.
Allocator and external-child semantics remain unresolved; FP architectural rounding, flags, traps, faults and concurrency are outside scope. No C, admission, or gates.
